title: Cabinet approves continuation of the PM-KISAN Scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a Financial Outlay of US$ 33 billion
description: The Union Cabinet has approved the continuation of the PM-KISAN Scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a financial outlay of US$ 33 billion to strengthen farmers' incomes, agricultural investment and rural prosperity.
